metadata.title: Reversible Higgs Bundles
metadata.abstract: We study reversible Higgs bundles on a compact Riemann surface $\Sigma$ of genus $g\geq 2$, that is, $G$-Higgs bundles $(E,\Phi)$ with $(E,\Phi)\cong(E,-\Phi)$. For a complex reductive group $G$ realized as a self-adjoint subgroup of $GL(n,\mathbb{C})$, we show that if $(E,\Phi)$ corresponds to a representation $\rho$ of $\pi_1(\Sigma)$, then $(E,-\Phi)$ corresponds to $(\overline{\rho}^{\,t})^{-1}$. As a consequence, the moduli space of reversible Higgs bundles is the fixed locus of an involution of the character variety and carries the structure of a real affine algebraic set. For a connected semisimple group and every topological type, we prove that the reversible locus in the smooth moduli space is a $(B,A,A)$-brane. We then describe reversibility through spectral data: in even rank, for a smooth spectral curve, reversible Higgs bundles correspond to line bundles invariant under the involution $\eta\mapsto-\eta$; in odd rank, under natural genericity assumptions for which the spectral curve is nodal, we give a gluing criterion together with an explicit polystability condition. Finally, for $SL(2n,\mathbb{C})$ we construct a relative Fourier--Mukai transform over the regular locus of the Hitchin base and prove that it maps the structure sheaf of the reversible locus to an object whose support is exactly the regular degree-zero $PSp(2n,\mathbb{C})$-locus in the Langlands dual $PGL(2n,\mathbb{C})$-moduli space. This support is of type $(B,B,B)$.

analysis.workSummary: 研究与其 Higgs 场取负后同构的 reversible Higgs 丛，识别对应的特征簇对合不动点及实仿射结构；在指定群与光滑模空间条件下证明其为 (B,A,A)-brane，并通过谱曲线及相对 Fourier–Mukai 变换描述对偶支撑。
techniques: 非阿贝尔 Hodge 对应
analysis.breakthrough: 把可逆性同时连接到表示论中的对合、brane 几何与 Langlands 对偶。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。奇偶秩采用不同的谱曲线假设；对偶支撑结果限于所述正规 Hitchin 基底及指定群，不能直接覆盖奇异全模空间。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
